contact.basis: Front porte-cochere roadway endpoint chosen in the independent whole-hotel frame before terrain/floor/main sections.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed Canyon Hotel historic map frame with explicitly approximate component registration. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.4m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.
Composite source relief can contain water-level, canopy and DEM void artifacts; it is not bathymetry or an exposed foundation survey. Source field does not certify historic ground contact.
